verdict.rationale: SOSPortal is an online filing, ordering and search platform, so in-product AI insights or suggestions are a fair question to ask of it. The documented features (filing, drafts, My Submissions status tracking, ordering copies, search, MFA, payments) include nothing AI-generated. The robots.txt ban on AI crawlers concerns external agent access, not in-product AI, so it is ignored here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
